# loopgen-rs

> Agentic loop runner for Claude Code — turns a goal into an iterative claude -p loop with a LOOP_STATUS termination contract (max-iter cap, optional verify gate, BLOCKED escape).

loopgen-rs is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/loopgen-rs/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/loopgen-rs): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install loopgen
```
